correctness.rationale: Edgewise two-step sign reversal follows from the nonnegative edge-sum identity for \(F^2(x)=x\). Direct dynamics checked 31,946,794 normalized initial states across six parameter pairs, and a distinct orientation enumerator checked 25 parameter pairs; both outputs were replayed from the supplied source files.

value.rationale: The number of initially periodic configurations and primitive temporal orbits is a natural invariant of a deterministic integer graph diffusion system. Exact counts for all double-star diameter-three trees distinguish two interacting hub branches from one-hub star dynamics, with an exceptional equal-arm family of exactly \(2a^{2a}\) states whose central edge remains tied. The full infinite-family closed count and its structural decomposition are not a routine one-parameter increment or known-table recomputation.
